ruling.recommended_action: Reject the route-deviation claim; no off-route segment and no overcharge found — keep the fare unchanged and note the rider complaint as unsubstantiated.

rejected_claims.reason: No off-route segment exists: actual distance 8.8 km is 0.1 km below the 8.9 km optimal route [F1][F3]; duration was 3.0 min under estimate [F2]. RD-1/RD-2 give extra_km = 0 and refund $0.00.

Even if a deviation had occurred, driver's rain/traffic excuse [F8] has no supporting traffic-incident fact [F11] and speed band 5 (40–49 km/h) is not band 1–2, so RD-4 would not exempt it; moot as no deviation exists.

Fare components reconcile exactly (base $3.90 + distance $12.42 + time $3.47 + platform $1.47 = $21.26) with 1.0× surge and $0.00 waiting [F4][F5]; no unpublished add-on, so FARE-1 yields nothing to refund.
